_note: Hand-curated, never scraped (spec §6). Every score is copied from the vendor's own model card, which means a row is measured under that vendor's harness and shot settings. Scores are comparable down a column with care and across vendors only loosely — which is why _source is recorded per model and shown on the page.

meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct._source: Meta Llama 3.1 model card, instruction-tuned evaluation table (MMLU 5-shot macro_avg/acc; MMLU-Pro 5-shot; GPQA 0-shot em; HumanEval pass@1; MATH 0-shot CoT). SWE-bench is not reported there.

meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct._source: Meta Llama 3.3 model card, instruction-tuned evaluation table (MMLU 0-shot CoT; MMLU-Pro 5-shot CoT; GPQA Diamond 0-shot CoT; HumanEval pass@1; MATH 0-shot CoT). SWE-bench is not reported there.

Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B._source: Not reported. The Qwen3-235B-A22B model card carries no evaluation table, and the Qwen3 blog publishes its numbers as chart images rather than text — nothing citable without transcribing a picture. Left null rather than guessed.
